content: JMdict dictionary data is provided by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG) under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license. MalangKey converts the source XML into an indexed SQLite database and derives ranking scores from JMdict priority markers.
